title: EventEnvelope
description: Envelope of every domain event (planning doc HSE section 101). Historical events add rule_version, source_event_ids and importance_level in a separate envelope defined by the history slice. Type schemas compose this with allOf and close the object with unevaluatedProperties:false.

event_id.description: Unique event id (UUIDv7). Storage and delivery idempotency key. Replay and determinism checks compare (world_id, tick, sequence) and content, not event_id.

recorded_at.description: Real time the server recorded the event. Audit only.

correlation_id.description: Groups all events of one gameplay transaction (e.g. one trade). Never null: system processes get their own correlation id.

causation_id.description: Id of the event or command that directly caused this event, or null.

actor_id.description: Acting entity id decided by the server, or null for system events.
